The Petitioner has filed its rejoinder affidavits to the replies of the above respondents on 30.7.2021. The Petitioner has also filed certain additional information on 12.5.2021, 4.6.2021 respectively. The Commission, after hearing the parties, on 30.11.2021, through video conferencing, reserved its order in the matter. The Petitioner has also filed certain additional information vide affidavits on 1.12.2021 and 31.12.2021 respectively.
